# Simplicity Pixel: the game's only font. 5-row glyphs, usually 3 wide (M, N, W are wider), one line each:
#   <char> <row1> <row2> <row3> <row4> <row5>
# Rows are top to bottom, "1" is a lit pixel. Lowercase uses the uppercase glyphs.
# Empty columns on the left and right are trimmed, so narrow glyphs ("I" excepted) take less space.
# Build with: python tools/build_font.py
